Ryan Gallagher  
San Francisco, CA | (555) 123-4567 | ryan.gallagher@email.com | linkedin.com/in/ryan-gallagher | portfolio.gallagher.io  

A seasoned data engineering leader with four years of experience in fintech, specializing in building scalable data pipelines, optimizing data warehouses, and driving operational excellence through cloud-native technologies. My expertise lies in translating complex business requirements into robust technical solutions, with a proven track record of enhancing data infrastructure to support real-time analytics and compliance-driven reporting.  

**Senior Data Engineer**  
CapitalFlow Inc. | San Francisco, CA | Jan 2022 – Present  
- Spearheaded the design and deployment of a Snowflake-based data warehouse, reducing ETL processing time by 40% through optimized schema design and partitioning strategies, enabling faster query performance for financial reporting.  
- Led the migration of legacy data pipelines from on-premises Hadoop to Cloud-based Apache Spark clusters, achieving a 30% reduction in compute costs while improving fault tolerance and scalability.  
- Developed a centralized ETL orchestration framework using Apache Airflow, streamlining cross-team collaboration and reducing deployment cycles from days to hours.  
- Collaborated with data scientists to refine data modeling practices, ensuring alignment between transactional and analytical data schemas, which improved data accuracy for risk assessment models by 25%.  
- Implemented a CI/CD pipeline for data pipeline testing, integrating automated validation checks that cut manual verification time by 50% and increased deployment reliability.  

**Data Engineer**  
CapitalFlow Inc. | San Francisco, CA | Jan 2021 – Dec 2021  
- Architectured a real-time data ingestion pipeline using Kafka and Spark Streaming, processing over 10 million transactions daily while maintaining sub-second latency for fraud detection systems.  
- Designed a data lake architecture on AWS S3, integrating with Snowflake for structured analytics, which supported the expansion of our client onboarding dashboard by 200%.  
- Optimized existing Spark jobs by rewriting them in Python for better resource utilization, resulting in a 22% reduction in runtime and improved cluster efficiency.  
- Partnered with the compliance team to build a regulatory reporting module, leveraging Snowflake’s role-based access controls to ensure data privacy and audit readiness.  

**Junior Data Engineer**  
FinTechNova | San Francisco, CA | Jan 2020 – Dec 2020  
- Built a Python-based ETL tool to automate the aggregation of customer transaction data, reducing manual effort by 60% and improving data consistency across departments.  
- Contributed to the development of a data warehouse schema, focusing on dimensional modeling for financial metrics, which became the foundation for our monthly performance dashboards.  

**Data Analyst**  
FinTechNova | San Francisco, CA | Jan 2019 – Dec 2019  
- Analyzed transactional data to identify trends in user behavior, supporting the launch of a new credit scoring model that increased loan approval rates by 15%.  
- Created ad-hoc reports using SQL and Tableau, providing actionable insights that drove a 10% improvement in customer retention metrics.  

**Bachelor of Science in Computer Science**  
University of Technology | Cape Town, South Africa | Graduated: 2019  

**Technical Skills / Technologies**  
- **Snowflake**: Engineered and maintained enterprise-grade data warehouses, leveraging its serverless architecture to scale to 150+ terabytes of data with minimal infrastructure overhead.  
- **Apache Spark**: Optimized batch and streaming pipelines for financial data processing, achieving 99.9% uptime during peak transaction periods.  
- **Data Modeling**: Designed star schemas and fact tables for financial reporting, ensuring alignment with GAAP standards and reducing query latency by 35%.  
- **Data Warehousing**: Architectured end-to-end data pipelines for compliance and analytics, integrating Snowflake with BI tools to deliver real-time insights to stakeholders.  
- **Python**: Automated data validation scripts and developed custom ETL logic, reducing manual intervention in data pipelines by 45%.  
- **Apache Airflow**: Integrated with Snowflake and Spark clusters to automate data workflows, reducing deployment time by 60% and improving team productivity.  
- **CI/CD Pipelines**: Implemented lightweight automation for data pipeline testing, ensuring deployments met quality thresholds without compromising agility.  

**Projects / Side Projects**  
- **Real-Time Fraud Detection System**: Built a Kafka-Spark-Redis pipeline to process and flag suspicious transactions in under 500ms, deployed at scale for a fintech client.  
- **Regulatory Reporting Dashboard**: Developed a Snowflake-powered dashboard with drill-down capabilities, enabling compliance teams to generate reports in minutes instead of hours.  
- **Machine Learning Pipeline**: Created a Python-based ETL framework for training credit risk models, integrating with Snowflake and ML platforms to automate feature engineering.
